description: Which LK ids match each wildcard pattern: *, ?, #, a*, *c, a?c, a#c, ?*, ???, #*, *#*, a bracketed *, ?, # or [ or ] inside a pattern, the ANSI-92 characters % and _ alone and inside a pattern (under DAO's ANSI-89 mode), the empty pattern, doubled * ? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
